name: The Doomed Fleet
summary: Bishop Farthing sends you north from Stormwind to seek a way past Morbent Fel's wards. The trail leads across Khaz Modan to the wreckage of Kul Tiras's Third Fleet off the Wetlands.

sections.title: A Weapon of Holy Truth
sections.body: Morbent Fel's wards turn aside ordinary steel at his retreat on the Forlorn Rowe. Bishop Farthing sends you to seek a weapon bound to the Holy Light. Its key is Lightforge Iron, a rare consecrated metal whose strikes carry holy truth and pierce sorcerous protections.

sections.title: The Wreck of the Third Fleet
sections.body: Duskwood has no supply of Lightforge Iron ready to hand. Bishop Farthing recalls that Kul Tiras's Third Fleet sank years ago along the dangerous Wetlands coast, north of Ironforge. One of its galleons carried a shipment of the precious ore. You travel to Menethil Harbor to meet Glorin Steelbrow, a dwarven contact who knows the marshes and their wrecks.

faq.q: Why do I have to travel all the way to the Wetlands?
faq.answer: Morbent Fel's dark enchantments turn aside ordinary attacks. Bishop Farthing says only a weapon forged from sacred Lightforge Iron can break through those wards. The known shipment lies among Kul Tiras's wrecked Third Fleet off Menethil Harbor.
Morbent Fel is a necromancer who dwells on the Forlorn Rowe in Duskwood. His sorcery has fueled much of the undead uprising threatening the region, and Darkshire's survival depends on defeating him.
Glorin Steelbrow is a dwarf at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. He is an ally of the Church of the Holy Light and knows the coastline, shipwrecks and salvage work in the marsh.
Lightforge Iron is a specially consecrated metal prized by the priesthood. Weapons forged from it carry holy power that can pierce dark shields and necromantic curses ordinary iron cannot overcome.

faq.q: What happened to the Third Fleet of Kul Tiras?
faq.answer: Years ago, Kul Tiras's Third Fleet sank along the rough, swampy Wetlands coast. Its hulls still lie beneath the water, with lost cargo and drowned sailors and aquatic predators among the wrecks.

faq.q: Does this quest involve any fighting right away?
faq.answer: You make this leg as a courier, traveling from Duskwood through the Kingdom of Stormwind and Khaz Modan to Menethil Harbor, where you contact Glorin Steelbrow.

angles.text: As a Paladin, you seek holy metal to strike down an unholy necromancer, using weapons sanctified by the Light to purge darkness.
As a Priest, you follow Bishop Farthing's guidance and the Church's old knowledge of blessed relics and consecrated ores.
As an Alliance traveler, you connect the isolated human towns of the south with dwarven harbors and ancient sea routes.
As a Blacksmith, you learn of rare Lightforge Iron, a metal imbued with faith and shaped by master craftsmanship.
